title: Brand Specialist I — Antigua
description: Brand Specialist I — Antigua Brightstar Lottery St. John Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 18/11/2026 Human Resources Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save Support Brightstar Lottery's brand and marketing initiatives by developing and executing integrated campaigns, analyzing performance, and coordinating cross-functional activities; onsite in Antigua. About the job Support Brightstar Lottery's brand management, marketing strategy, and portfolio growth through integrated marketing programs that strengthen brand positioning, drive revenue, and enhance customer engagement. This is an onsite role based in Antigua, working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to deliver consistent brand experiences. Key responsibilities Develop and implement integrated marketing plans and campaigns to support portfolio growth and visibility. Champion brand positioning and consumer engagement initiatives across channels and touchpoints. Coordinate advertising, promotions, pricing, and communications to strengthen market presence. Analyze brand performance, campaign effectiveness, market trends, and customer insights to inform recommendations. Collaborate with Sales, Business Intelligence, and cross-functional teams to execute strategic initiatives. Monitor competitor activity and industry developments to identify opportunities and risks. Facilitate training and educational initiatives to increase stakeholder understanding of products and brand objectives. Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field. 2–5 years' experience in brand management, advertising, marketing, or market analysis. Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns. Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret data, market trends, and consumer insights. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with business reporting tools. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Desirable Experience in lottery, gaming, consumer products, retail, or regulated industries. Familiarity with market research methodologies and customer insight analysis. Knowledge of brand development, portfolio planning, and go-to-market execution. Exposure to agency management, media planning, and vendor partnerships. Understanding of digital marketing and integrated communications. Experience in multicultural, cross-functional environments. Location: Onsite in Antigua. Ref: BOS AG Apply Now
